title: Piteous
summary: PIT'EOUS, adjective [See Pity.] Sorrowful; mournful; that may excite pity; as a piteous look. 1. Wretched; miserable; deserving compassion; as a piteous condition. 2. Compassionate; affected by pity.

inlines.v: PIT'EOUS, adjective [See Pity.] Sorrowful; mournful; that may excite pity; as a piteous look. 1. Wretched; miserable; deserving compassion; as a piteous condition. 2. Compassionate; affected by pity. 3. Pitiful; paltry; poor; as piteous amends.
